rejectedObservations.observation: Sonner next-themes replacement pattern (useSyncExternalStore reading data-theme) should be documented as project convention
rejectedObservations.reason: This is a shadcn/ui implementation detail internal to the component. Documenting it provides little value to future workers who would encounter the same standard shadcn adaptation.

rejectedObservations.observation: ProfileProvider context value object should be memoized with useMemo
rejectedObservations.reason: Suggestion-level optimization. Profile changes infrequently and the performance impact is negligible. Over-optimization of context values can introduce bugs if done incorrectly.

rejectedObservations.observation: ProfileProvider should add storage event listener for cross-tab sync
rejectedObservations.reason: Suggestion-level enhancement. The feature provides reloadProfile() for manual sync. Cross-tab sync is not a requirement for the current feature scope.

rejectedObservations.observation: PaletteName should be typed as union instead of string
rejectedObservations.reason: Non-blocking. Runtime validation exists via validatePalette(). A union type of 16 names would be verbose and provide minimal benefit since palette selection is always user-driven, not code-driven.

rejectedObservations.observation: Missing CSS transition for theme switching (VAL-THEME-004)
rejectedObservations.reason: VAL-THEME-004 validation will be tested during user-testing-validator. The current smoothness is acceptable and any transition tuning is better done with visual feedback from user testing.

rejectedObservations.observation: db.ts exposes setDb()/getDb() testing helpers not in original db.js
rejectedObservations.reason: This is a standard testing pattern (dependency injection). Documenting it in AGENTS.md would add noise. Future workers encountering the test files will see the pattern directly.
